03 / THE BUSINESS BEHIND THE BUILD

Small enough to listen.
Focused enough to build.

YUTECH SOLUTIONS is a registered, founder-led software business in Zambia.

Founded and owned by Miyambo Joseph, the business brings a practical approach to software: understand the problem, build a useful solution, and keep improving it.

EatPay is our flagship product and an example of that approach—connecting the people and processes behind everyday meal ordering.
